9. MERGE THE PERSONAL-AGENT VISION INTO THIS FOUNDATION
Oscar explicitly makes the harness first priority and the separate “Vision clarification for AGI-like personal agent” project second priority. Incorporate the reusable design principles and wanted outcomes from that project's vision into this harness; preserve its existing work and evidence rather than merging its whole codebase or launching its deployment. The 30 August user-authored north-star clarification was recovered from session 31d01870; locate the canonical input ledger and current implementation before transferring artifacts. That session's latest visible handoff references pi-connectors, pi-autonomy and pi-instrument; these are pointers, not release proof.

The intended effect is broad assistance across permitted work; durable readiness; reliable concurrent/long-running tasks; continuity through compaction/restarts; minimal user coordination; correct visible holds; safe recovery without duplicate effects; and continuous evidence-backed improvement. “AGI-like” names this aspiration, not a present capability claim. Separate the reusable harness core from optional agent-product features such as persistent scheduling or background activation. Design compatible interfaces now; implement the smallest bounded core before optional always-on features.

Preserve fixed purpose and user-controlled authority. Version modular prompts, tools, memory, skills, workflows and evaluators. The improvement loop is observe → diagnose → research → propose candidate → isolate → paired evaluation → independent review → authorized canary → monitor → retain or roll back. An agent must not widen its own authority, change an evaluator to pass itself, learn hidden test answers, hide negative results, or promote from self-attestation. Existing proof/model-check results retain their exact scope. Do not reinterpret this consolidation as permission for live migrations, persistent activation, soak tests, paid calls or public rollout. Establish a requirements crosswalk: transferred principle → current core mechanism → unmet gap → fixed evidence → implementation/second-priority product owner.
